environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with pod security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The pod spec does NOT include any volumeMounts for /tmp or any other writable tmpfs. The container image uses a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static) with no shell binary (/bin/sh absent). Node-level enforcement via PodSecurity admission controller in 'restricted' mode with audit+enforce. The OCI runtime spec generated by containerd reflects rootfs mounted as ro with no additional writable mounts in the mount namespace.

config.note: No tmpfs, emptyDir, or hostPath volumes attached. /tmp is part of the read-only rootfs overlay.
